prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the best agency for you depends on your organization, goals, budget and required services. I can recommend specific St. Louis firms if you tell me what you need, or I can give you a short checklist and vetting questions so you can pick confidently.

To help me recommend the right agencies, tell me:
- What type of healthcare organization are you? (hospital system, private practice, specialty clinic, med device, pharma, etc.)
- Primary goals (patient acquisition, brand awareness, physician recruitment, product launch, reputation management, etc.)
- Services you need (digital ads, SEO, web design, PR, content, creative/branding, data analytics, CRM/EHR integration)
- Approximate annual budget and timeline
- Any must-haves (HIPAA experience, bilingual marketing, local media connections, experience with Medicare/Medicaid audiences, etc.)

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, use this checklist and these interview questions.

Checklist — what to look for
- Healthcare experience: proven case studies in healthcare or regulated industries.
- HIPAA and privacy knowledge: policies, BAAs, secure processes.
- Measurable results: leads, ROI, cost-per-acquisition, conversion lifts with case data.
- Digital capabilities: SEO, paid media, marketing automation, analytics.
- Integration experience: CRM/EHR or patient intake systems if needed.
- Creative and storytelling: patient-facing content, physician outreach, reputation management.
- Local relationships: referral networks, media, community outreach (if patient acquisition is local).
- References and transparency: client references, clear reporting cadence, contract terms.

Key questions to ask prospects
1. Have you worked with organizations like ours? Can you share relevant case studies and outcomes?
2. How do you handle HIPAA and other healthcare/data compliance?
3. What KPIs will you measure and how often will you report?
4. Who will be on our team and how much senior-level time will we get?
5. What is your pricing model and what’s included (retainer, project, media spend)?
6. How do you approach patient acquisition vs. brand/PR work?
7. Can you show examples of creative and patient-facing content you produced?
8. Provide two references we can contact.

Red flags
- No healthcare case studies or inability to explain compliance.
- Vague reporting or no defined KPIs.
- Overpromising (e.g., guarantees of rankings or patient numbers without data).
- No client references or poor turnover on the account team.

If you want, tell me the details above and I’ll produce a tailored short list of St. Louis agencies (small, mid, and large) that fit your needs plus suggested outreach language and a scoring rubric to compare proposals. Which would you prefer?
